name: Protect Kaya
summary: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Kaya Flathoof is found captive among hostile Grimtotem tauren. Horde adventurers guide her along dangerous mountain trails to Camp Aparaje, then bring word of her survival to her anxious father, Makaba Flathoof.

sections.title: A Captive in the Crags
sections.body: Kaya Flathoof was captured and held prisoner deep in Grimtotem territory in the Stonetalon Mountains. The tauren clans are divided by bitter rivalries, and few are sharper than the hostility surrounding the Grimtotem. Kaya has escaped captivity, but reaching friendly ground on foot means winding through trails watched by enemies and predators. An armed escort is her best hope of getting through.

sections.title: Flight to Camp Aparaje
sections.body: Camp Aparaje lies in the eastern Stonetalon Mountains, and Kaya knows the way home from there. She aims for the camp, where she can continue on her own. You guide her through paths where ambushes threaten, helping her avoid recapture on the way to safety.

sections.title: A Father's Relief
sections.body: Makaba Flathoof waits near Stonetalon's southeastern border, fearing the worst for his missing daughter. Runners bring confirmation that Kaya reached Camp Aparaje safely. Makaba's despair gives way to gratitude for the champions who stood between his child and her captors.

faq.answer: Kaya Flathoof is a young tauren captured by hostile Grimtotem forces in the Stonetalon Mountains. She depends on passing Horde adventurers to help her escape and reach safe ground.

faq.q: Where does Kaya need to be escorted?
faq.answer: Kaya needs an escort along the trails to Camp Aparaje in eastern Stonetalon, where she knows her way home.
Makaba Flathoof is Kaya's father, waiting anxiously near the southeastern entrance to the Stonetalon Mountains. He fears for his missing child until adventurers bring word that she has been rescued.
Hostile Grimtotem tauren captured Kaya. Their camps and ambushes lie across the crags of Stonetalon.

faq.q: What happens after Kaya reaches Camp Aparaje?
faq.answer: Once Kaya reaches Camp Aparaje, she can find her own way home. You then return to Makaba Flathoof with the joyful news that she survived.

faq.q: Is this quest available to Alliance players?
faq.answer: No. The Flathoof family are peaceful tauren aligned with the Horde, so this rescue is exclusive to Horde adventurers.

angles.text: As a tauren, you help a fellow of your kin caught in the Grimtotem clan's aggression.
As a member of the Horde, you help keep traveling families safe and reinforce the Horde's hard-won footholds and supply routes in Stonetalon.
